method: Every listed raw frame personally inspected; individual SHA-256 retained after raw cleanup. Contact sheets only for presentation, no pixel manipulation.
observation: All34 low/high current frames inspected: technician147/154 walks through actual open door, glances, takes parcel, signs, carries it inside and closes door. Both707-tick strips retain364 transfer ticks with zero simulation-hidden ticks and actual Delivered latch. Six negative controls pass. Compared against archived labelled PROD panels from visual-qa-13j: current coat/goggles/gloves/clipboard, hands/parcel and full scene framing are at least as legible. This is an archived PROD reference, not a newly built live deployment.
